strategy.bands: Per-code actual float32 encoder witnesses, fixed-source-bound cached probes, full inclusive represented endpoints for all unselected codes. Saturated sides remain unbounded. Every incumbent optical value must belong to its saved code band or refinement is unknown. Witnesses are operational, not certified global libm inverse intervals.
strategy.selected_target: Central half of the adjacent represented finite bin: L+w/4 toU-w/4. For selected saturation only, use the finite proposal slice[0,U] or[L,256] before central-half restriction; do not add these fake finite sides to protected saturation bins. No overshoot after QP.
strategy.local_qp: min .5||delta||^2 subject to lower<=actual_z0+Gdelta<=upper and original normalized7D displacement box, fixed-span delta=0. Halfspace dual Hildreth/Dykstra coordinate updates with nonnegative multipliers and zero initialization.
strategy.solver_validity: Require current primal/dual/complementarity/stationarity/gap engineering checks and original computed raw optical bands/box without tolerance widening. Tiny movement or delta+A^Tlambda invariant alone is not convergence. Finite cap without passing checks is unknown, not infeasible/stationary. Only a genuine zero-row contradiction may assert local surrogate infeasibility.
strategy.literal_acceptance: Any strict decrease in actual complete PNG training cost may be accepted, even if nonlinear actual source codes differ from the local protected pattern. Retain and label all actual selected/other-bin differences. QP feasibility never certifies nonlinear feasibility or identifiability.
strategy.archive: Retain actual encoded arrays for every newly computed protected-phase literal candidate, rejected/polish included; cache-hit trials refer to retained candidate snapshots. Reserve bounded code-entry capacity before new literal work. Missing/failed stages retain explicit reasons, no model replay to fill them.
strategy.completion: Only original best-linked literal coordinate polish plus sound global source/work/protocol state may satisfy unchanged local-completion target. QP status itself supplies no original geometry-rank or stopping certificate.

limits.solver_reservation: Reserve whole setup/sweep before corresponding arithmetic, one ledger record per setup/sweep; retain actual attempted prefix and pending suffix. These engineering units are not hardware cycles.
limits.score_stage_work: E*(8*Q+8), where E is valid adjacent-code event count across actual source cells and Q is training query count; reserve before ranking,0geometry evaluation units. Sorting/serialization are bounded metadata.
